note: THE INTAKE: where a Drive link becomes a wall. Paste share links here, push, and .github/workflows/fetch-wall.yml pulls them on a GitHub runner (which can reach Drive; the build sandbox can't), web-lights them, strips the EXIF, and writes them into data/gallery.json. Every event id here must already exist in data/gallery.json. Sharing on the Drive folder or file MUST be 'Anyone with the link' with 'Viewer' access, or the runner gets a login page instead of a photo.

walls.hint: Put ONE Drive folder link in "folder", or a list of individual file links in "files"; either works, both together is fine. "cover" is which photo (1-based, after sorting) becomes the event's cover. "sell" puts the wall in the print shop.

walls.sellNote: Print sales OFF. The frames are of young people at a mentoring programme, and putting children's photographs on public sale is a different thing from showing the work. Flip to true once the chapter confirms the releases cover commercial sale.

Print sales OFF, same reasoning as Dressed for Success: a chapter event that may carry young members, and a hospital interior on top of it. Flip once the frames are looked at and the chapter signs off.
